And the damsel \add as\add* very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king kne her not.
Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I ill be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also \add as\add* a very goodly \add man;\add* and \add his mother\add* bare him after Absalom.
And he conferred ith Joab the son of Zeruiah, and ith Abiathar the priest: and they folloing Adonijah helped \add him\add*.
But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty \add men\add* hich \add belonged\add* to David, ere not ith Adonijah.
And Adonijah sle sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, hich \add is\add* by En-rogel, and called all his brethren the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah the king’s servants:
but Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty \add men\add*, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoeth \add it\add* not?
No therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine on life, and the life of thy son Solomon.

Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord O king, sear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? hy then doth Adonijah reign?
Behold, hile thou yet talkest there ith the king, I also ill come in after thee, and confirm thy ords.
And Bath-sheba ent in unto the king into the chamber: and the king as very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.
And Bath-sheba boed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What ouldest thou?
And she said unto him, My lord, thou sarest by the \sc Lord\sc* thy God unto thine handmaid, \add saying\add*, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.
And no behold, Adonijah reigneth; and no, my lord the king, thou knoest \add it\add* not:

and he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.
And thou, my lord O king, the eyes of all Israel \add are\add* upon thee, that \add thou\add* shouldest tell them ho shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
Otherise it shall come to pass, hen my lord the king shall sleep ith his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be \add counted\add* offenders.
And lo, hile she yet talked ith the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.
And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And hen he as come in before the king, he boed himself before the king ith his face to the ground.
And Nathan said, My lord O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?

For he is gone don \add this\add* day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king’s sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.
But me, \add even\add* me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.
Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not sheed \add it\add* unto thy servant, ho should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?
Then king David ansered and said, Call me Bath-sheba. And she came into the king’s presence, and stood before the king.
And the king sare, and said, \add As\add* the \sc Lord\sc* liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,
even as I sare unto thee by the \sc Lord\sc* God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so ill I certainly do this day.
Then Bath-sheba boed \add ith her\add* face \add to\add* the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
The king also said unto them, Take ith you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine on mule, and bring him don to Gihon:
and let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blo ye ith the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.
Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.
And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada ansered the king, and said, Amen: the \sc Lord\sc* God of my lord the king say so \add too\add*.
As the \sc Lord\sc* hath been ith my lord the king, even so be he ith Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.

So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, ent don, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
And Zadok the priest took a horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they ble the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.

And Adonijah and all the guests that \add ere\add* ith him heard \add it\add* as they had made an end of eating. And hen Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore \add is this\add* noise of the city being in an uproar?
And hile he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said \add unto him\add*, Come in; for thou \add art\add* a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.

and Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This \add is\add* the noise that ye have heard.

No the days of David dre nigh that \add he\add* should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
I go the ay of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and she thyself a man;

and keep the charge of the \sc Lord\sc* thy God, to alk in his ays, to keep his statutes, \add and\add* his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as \add it is\add* ritten in the la of Moses, that thou mayest prosper \add in\add* all that thou doest, and hithersoever thou turnest thyself:

that the \sc Lord\sc* may continue his ord hich he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their ay, to alk before me in truth ith all their heart and ith all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.

Moreover thou knoest also hat Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, \add and\add* hat he did to the to captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, hom he sle, and shed the blood of ar in peace, and put the blood of ar upon his girdle that \add as\add* about his loins, and in his shoes that \add ere\add* on his feet.

And Solomon made affinity ith Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his on house, and the house of the \sc Lord\sc*, and the all of Jerusalem round about.

And Solomon said, Thou hast sheed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he alked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart ith thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as \add it is\add* this day.

And Solomon aoke; and behold, \add it as\add* a dream. And he came \add to\add* Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the \sc Lord\sc*, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.

And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon’s table, every man \add in\add* his month: they lacked nothing.

And God gave Solomon isdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, \add even\add* as the sand that \add is\add* on the sea shore.

And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram as ever a lover of David.
And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

Thou knoest ho that David my father could not build a house unto the name of the \sc Lord\sc* his God for the ars hich ere about him on every side, until the \sc Lord\sc* put them under the soles of his feet.

And the \sc Lord\sc* said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have halloed this house, hich thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

And if thou ilt alk before me, as David thy father alked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, \add and\add* ilt keep my statutes and my judgments:
then I ill establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.

\add But\add* if you shall at all turn from folloing me, you or your children, and ill not keep my commandments \add and\add* my statutes hich I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and orship them:

then ill I cut off Israel out of the land hich I have given them; and \add this\add* house, hich I have halloed for my name, ill I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byord among all people:

and \add at\add* this house, \add hich\add* is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the \sc Lord\sc* done thus unto this land, and to this house?

And they shall anser, Because they forsook the \sc Lord\sc* their God, ho brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have orshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the \sc Lord\sc* brought upon them all this evil.
And it came to pass at the end of tenty years, hen Solomon had built the to houses, the house of the \sc Lord\sc*, and the king’s house,

(\add no\add* Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon ith cedar trees and fir trees, and ith gold, according to all his desire,) \add that\add* then king Solomon gave Hiram tenty cities in the land of Galilee.
And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities hich Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.
And he said, What cities \add are\add* these hich thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.
And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.

And this \add is\add* the reason of the levy hich king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the \sc Lord\sc*, and his on house, and Millo, and the all of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.

\add For\add* Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it ith fire, and slain the Canaanites that delt in the city, and given it \add for\add* a present unto his daughter, Solomon’s ife.
And Solomon built Gezer, and Beth-horon the nether,
and Baalath, and Tadmor in the ilderness, in the land,

and all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that hich Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
\add And\add* all the people that ere left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, hich \add ere\add* not of the children of Israel,
their children that ere left after them in the land, hom the children of Israel also ere not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.
But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondman: but they \add ere\add* men of ar, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.
These \add ere\add* the chief of the officers that \add ere\add* over Solomon’s ork, five hundred and fifty, hich bare rule over the people that rought in the ork.
But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house hich \add Solomon\add* had built for her: then did he build Millo.

And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar hich he built unto the \sc Lord\sc*, and he burnt incense upon the altar that \add as\add* before the \sc Lord\sc*. So he finished the house.
And king Solomon made a navy \add of ships\add* in Ezion-geber, hich \add is\add* beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.
And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knoledge of the sea, ith the servants of Solomon.
And they came to Ophir, and fet from thence gold, four hundred and tenty talents, and brought \add it\add* to king Solomon.
And hen the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the \sc Lord\sc*, she came to prove him ith hard questions.

And she came to Jerusalem ith a very great train, \add ith\add* camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and hen she as come to Solomon, she communed ith him of all that as in her heart.
And Solomon told her all her questions: there as not \add any\add* thing hid from the king, hich he told her not.
And hen the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon’s isdom, and the house that he had built,

and the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent \add by\add* hich he ent up \add unto\add* the house of the \sc Lord\sc*; there as no more spirit in her.
And she said to the king, It as a true report that I heard in mine on land of thy acts and of thy isdom.
Hobeit I believed not the ords, until I came, and mine eyes had seen \add it:\add* and behold, the half as not told me: thy isdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame hich I heard.
Happy \add are\add* thy men, happy \add are\add* these thy servants, hich stand continually before thee, \add and\add* that hear thy isdom.

Blessed be the \sc Lord\sc* thy God, hich delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the \sc Lord\sc* loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.

And she gave the king an hundred and tenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these hich the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.

And the king made \add of\add* the almug trees pillars for the house of the \sc Lord\sc*, and for the king’s house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor ere seen unto this day.

And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, hat\add soever\add* she asked, besides \add that\add* hich Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and ent to her on country, she and her servants.
No the eight of gold that came to Solomon in one year as six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,

beside \add that he had\add* of the merchantmen, and \add of\add* the traffick of the \add spice\add* merchants, and \add of\add* all the kings of Arabia, and \add of\add* the governors of the country.
And king Solomon made to hundred targets \add of\add* beaten gold: six hundred \add shekels\add* of gold ent to one target.
And \add he made\add* three hundred shields \add of\add* beaten gold; three pound \add of\add* gold ent to one shield: and the king put them \add in\add* the house of the forest of Lebanon.
Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it ith the best gold.
The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne \add as\add* round behind: and \add there ere\add* stays on either side on the place of the seat, and to lions stood beside the stays.
And telve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there as not the like made in any kingdom.

And all king Solomon’s drinking vessels \add ere of\add* gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon \add ere of\add* pure gold: none \add ere of\add* silver: it as nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish ith the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for isdom.
And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his isdom, hich God had put in his heart.
And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and telve thousand horsemen, hom he bestoed in the cities for chariots, and ith the king at Jerusalem.
And the king made silver \add to be\add* in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he \add to be\add* as the sycomore trees that \add are\add* in the vale, for abundance.
And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

And a chariot came up and ent out of Egypt for six hundred \add shekels\add* of silver, and a horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring \add them\add* out by their means.
But king Solomon loved many strange omen, together ith the daughter of Pharaoh, \add omen of the\add* Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, \add and\add* Hittites;

of the nations \add concerning\add* hich the \sc Lord\sc* said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: \add for\add* surely they ill turn aay your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.
And he had seven hundred ives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his ives turned aay his heart.

For it came to pass, hen Solomon as old, \add that\add* his ives turned aay his heart after other gods: and his heart as not perfect ith the \sc Lord\sc* his God, as \add as\add* the heart of David his father.
For Solomon ent after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
And Solomon did evil in the sight of the \sc Lord\sc*, and ent not fully after the \sc Lord\sc*, as \add did\add* David his father.
Then did Solomon build a high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that \add is\add* before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.
And likeise did he for all his strange ives, hich burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
And the \sc Lord\sc* as angry ith Solomon, because his heart as turned from the \sc Lord\sc* God of Israel, hich had appeared unto him tice,
and had commanded him concerning this thing, that \add he\add* should not go after other gods: but he kept not \add that\add* hich the \sc Lord\sc* commanded.

Wherefore the \sc Lord\sc* said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, hich I have commanded thee, I ill surely rend the kingdom from thee, and ill give it to thy servant.
Notithstanding in thy days I ill not do it for David thy father’s sake: \add but\add* I ill rend it out of the hand of thy son.
Hobeit I ill not rend aay all the kingdom; \add but\add* ill give one tribe to thy son for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake, hich I have chosen.
And the \sc Lord\sc* stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he \add as\add* of the king’s seed in Edom.
For it came to pass, hen David as in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host as gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;
(for six months did Joab remain there ith all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
that Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants ith him, to go \add into\add* Egypt; Hadad \add being yet\add* a little child.

And they arose out of Midian, and came \add to\add* Paran: and they took men ith them out of Paran, and they came \add to\add* Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; hich gave him a house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.
And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him \add to\add* ife the sister of his on ife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, hom Tahpenes eaned in Pharaoh’s house: and Genubath as \add in\add* Pharaoh’s household among the sons of Pharaoh.
And hen Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept ith his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host as dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine on country.
Then Pharaoh said unto him, But hat \add hast\add* thou lacked ith me, that behold, thou seekest to go to thine on country? And he ansered, Nothing: hobeit let me go in any ise.
And God stirred him up \add another\add* adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, hich fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:
and he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, hen David sle them \add of Zobah:\add* and they ent \add to\add* Damascus, and delt therein, and reigned in Damascus.
And he as an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad \add did:\add* and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon’s servant, hose mother’s name \add as\add* Zeruah, a ido oman, even he lift up \add his\add* hand against the king.
And this \add as\add* the cause that he lift up \add his\add* hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, \add and\add* repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.
And the man Jeroboam \add as\add* a mighty \add man\add* of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he as industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.

And it came to pass at that time hen Jeroboam ent out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the ay; and he had clad himself ith a ne garment; and they to \add ere\add* alone in the field:
and Ahijah caught the ne garment that \add as\add* on him, and rent it \add in\add* telve pieces:
and he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the \sc Lord\sc*, the God of Israel, Behold, I ill rent the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and ill give ten tribes to thee:
(but he shall have one tribe for my servant David’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city hich I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)

because that they have forsaken me, and have orshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not alked in my ays, to do \add that\add* hich \add is\add* right in mine eyes, and \add to keep\add* my statutes and my judgments, as \add did\add* David his father.
Hobeit I ill not take the hole kingdom out of his hand: but I ill make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake, hom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:
but I ill take the kingdom out of his son’s hand, and ill give it unto thee, \add even\add* ten tribes.
And unto his son ill I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alay before me in Jerusalem, the city hich I have chosen me to put my name there.
And I ill take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.

And it shall be, if thou ilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and ilt alk in my ays, and do that \add is\add* right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I ill be ith thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and ill give Israel unto thee.
And I ill for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.
Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled \add into\add* Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and as in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his isdom, \add are\add* they not ritten in the book of the acts of Solomon?
And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel \add as\add* forty years.
And Solomon slept ith his fathers, and as buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
And Rehoboam ent \add to\add* Shechem: for all Israel ere come \add to\add* Shechem to make him king.
And it came to pass, hen Jeroboam the son of Nebat, ho as yet in Egypt, heard \add of it\add*, (for he as fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam delt in Egypt;)
that they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,
Thy father made our yoke grievous: no therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke hich he put upon us, lighter, and e ill serve thee.
And he said unto them, Depart yet \add for\add* three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.
And king Rehoboam consulted ith the old men, that stood before Solomon his father hile he \add yet\add* lived, and said, Ho do you advise that \add I\add* may anser this people?
And they spake unto him, saying, If thou ilt be a servant unto \add this\add* people this day, and ilt serve them, and anser them, and speak good ords to them, then they ill be thy servants for ever.
But he forsook the counsel of the old men, hich they had given him, and consulted ith the young men that ere gron up ith him, \add and\add* hich stood before him:
and he said unto them, What counsel give ye that e may anser this people, ho have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke hich thy father did put upon us lighter?

And the young men that ere gron up ith him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou \add it\add* lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little \add finger\add* shall be thicker than my father’s loins.
And no hereas my father did lade you ith a heavy yoke, I ill add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you ith hips, but I ill chastise you ith scorpions.
So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.
And the king ansered the people roughly, and forsook the old men’s counsel that they gave him;

and spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I ill add to your yoke: my father \add also\add* chastised you ith hips, but I ill chastise you ith scorpions.

Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause as from the \sc Lord\sc*, that \add he\add* might perform his saying, hich the \sc Lord\sc* spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

So hen all Israel sa that the king hearkened not unto them, the people ansered the king, saying, What portion have e in David? Neither \add have e\add* inheritance in the son of Jesse: To your tents, O Israel: No see to thine on house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.
But \add as for\add* the children of Israel hich delt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, ho \add as\add* over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him ith stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get \add him\add* up to \add his\add* chariot, to flee \add to\add* Jerusalem.

And it came to pass, hen all Israel heard that Jeroboam as come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there as none that folloed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.

And hen Rehoboam as come \add to\add* Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, ith the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen \add men\add*, hich ere arriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
But the ord of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and \add to\add* the remnant of the people, saying,

Thus saith the \sc Lord\sc*, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the ord of the \sc Lord\sc*, and returned to depart, according to the ord of the \sc Lord\sc*.
Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and delt therein; and ent out from thence, and built Penuel.
And Jeroboam said in his heart, No shall the kingdom return to the house of David:

if this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the \sc Lord\sc* at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, \add even\add* unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.

Whereupon the king took counsel, and made to calves of gold, and said unto them, \add It is\add* too much for you to go up \add to\add* Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, hich brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
And he set the one in Beth-el, and the other put he in Dan.
And this thing became a sin: for the people ent \add to orship\add* before the one, \add even\add* unto Dan.
And he made a house of high places, and made priests of the loest of the people, hich ere not of the sons of Levi.

And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that \add is\add* in Judah, and he offered upon the altar (so did he in Beth-el,) sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Beth-el the priests of the high places hich he had made.

So he offered upon the altar hich he had made in Beth-el the fifteenth day of the eighth month, \add even\add* in the month hich he had devised of his on heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.

And he cried against the altar in the ord of the \sc Lord\sc*, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the \sc Lord\sc*; Behold, a child \add shall be\add* born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men’s bones shall be burnt upon thee.

And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This \add is\add* the sign hich the \sc Lord\sc* hath spoken; Behold, the altar \add shall be\add* rent, and the ashes that \add are\add* upon it shall be poured out.

And it came to pass, hen king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, hich had cried against the altar in Beth-el, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, hich he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.
The altar also \add as\add* rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign hich the man of God had given by the ord of the \sc Lord\sc*.

And the king ansered and said unto the man of God, Intreat no the face of the \sc Lord\sc* thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the \sc Lord\sc*, and the king’s hand as restored him again, and became as \add it as\add* before.
And the king said unto the man of God, Come home ith me, and refresh \add thyself\add*, and I ill give thee a reard.
And the man of God said unto the king, If thou ilt give me half thine house, I ill not go in ith thee, neither ill I eat bread nor drink ater in this place:
for so as it charged me by the ord of the \sc Lord\sc*, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink ater, nor turn again by the \add same\add* ay that thou camest.
So he ent another ay, and returned not by the ay that he came to Beth-el.

No there delt an old prophet in Beth-el; and his son came and told him all the orks that the man of God had done \add that\add* day in Beth-el: the ords hich he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.
And their father said unto them, What ay ent he? For his sons had seen hat ay the man of God ent, hich came from Judah.
And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
and ent after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, \add Art\add* thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I \add am\add*.
Then he said unto him, Come home ith me, and eat bread.
And he said, I may not return ith thee, nor go in ith thee: neither ill I eat bread nor drink ater ith thee in this place:
for it as said to me by the ord of the \sc Lord\sc*, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink ater there, nor turn again to go by the ay that thou camest.

He said unto him, I \add am\add* a prophet also as thou \add art;\add* and an angel spake unto me by the ord of the \sc Lord\sc*, saying, Bring him back ith thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink ater. \add But\add* he lied unto him.
So he ent back ith him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank ater.
And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the ord of the \sc Lord\sc* came unto the prophet that brought him back:

and he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the \sc Lord\sc*, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the \sc Lord\sc*, and hast not kept the commandment hich the \sc Lord\sc* thy God commanded thee,

but camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk ater in the place, of the hich \add the \+sc Lord\+sc*\add* did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no ater; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.
And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, \add to it\add*, for the prophet hom he had brought back.
And hen he as gone, a lion met him by the ay, and sle him: and his carcase as cast in the ay, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.
And behold, men passed by, and sa the carcase cast in the ay, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told \add it\add* in the city here the old prophet delt.

And hen the prophet that brought him back from the ay heard \add thereof\add*, he said, It \add is\add* the man of God, ho as disobedient unto the ord of the \sc Lord\sc*: therefore the \sc Lord\sc* hath delivered him unto the lion, hich hath torn him, and slain him, according to the ord of the \sc Lord\sc*, hich he spake unto him.
And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled \add him\add*.
And he ent and found his carcase cast in the ay, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.
And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.
And he laid his carcase in his on grave; and they mourned over him, \add saying\add*, Alas, my brother.

And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre herein the man of God \add is\add* buried; lay my bones beside his bones:

for the saying hich he cried by the ord of the \sc Lord\sc* against the altar in Beth-el, and against all the houses of the high places hich \add are\add* in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.

After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil ay, but made again of the loest of the people priests of the high places: hosoever ould, he consecrated him, and he became \add one of\add* the priests of the high places.
And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut \add it\add* off, and to destroy \add it\add* from off the face of the earth.
At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.

And Jeroboam said to his ife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not knon to be the ife of Jeroboam; and get thee \add to\add* Shiloh: behold, there \add is\add* Ahijah the prophet, hich told me that I should be king over this people.

And the son of Shammai \add as\add* Maon: and Maon \add as\add* the father of Beth-zur.
And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb \add as\add* Achsah.
These ere the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim,
Salma the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons; Haroeh, \add and\add* half of the Manahethites.
And the families of Kirjath-jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
The sons of Salma; Beth-lehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.

And the families of the scribes hich delt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, \add and\add* Suchathites. These \add are\add* the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
No these ere the sons of David, hich ere born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
the third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his ife.
\add These\add* six ere born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
And these ere born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel:
Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
\add These ere\add* all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
And Solomon’s son \add as\add* Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
Amon his son, Josiah his son.
And the sons of Josiah \add ere\add*, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
And the sons of Pedaiah \add ere\add*, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the son of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.
And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
And the sons of Elioenai \add ere\add*, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These \add are\add* the families of the Zorathites.
And these \add ere of\add* the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister \add as\add* Hazelelponi:
and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These \add are\add* the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Beth-lehem.
And Ashur the father of Tekoa had to ives, Helah and Naarah.
And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These \add ere\add* the sons of Naarah.
And the sons of Helah \add ere\add*, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
And Jabez as more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare \add him\add* ith sorro.

And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou ouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be ith me, and that thou ouldest keep \add me\add* from evil, that it may not grieve me. And God granted \add him that\add* hich he requested.
And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, hich \add as\add* the father of Eshton.
And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These \add are\add* the men of Rechah.
And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.
And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they ere craftsmen.
And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
And the sons of Ezra \add ere\add*, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

And his ife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these \add are\add* the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, hich Mered took.
And the sons of \add his\add* ife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
And the sons of Shimon \add ere\add*, Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi \add ere\add*, Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.
The sons of Shelah the son of Judah \add ere\add*, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that rought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
and Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, ho had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And \add these are\add* ancient things.
These \add ere\add* the potters, and those that delt amongst plants and hedges: there they delt ith the king for his ork.
The sons of Simeon \add ere\add*, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, \add and\add* Shaul:
Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.
And they delt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual,
and at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
and at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
and at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-birei, and at Shaaraim. These \add ere\add* their cities unto the reign of David.
And their villages \add ere\add*, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:
and all their villages that \add ere\add* round about the same cities, unto Baal. These \add ere\add* their habitations, and their genealogy.
And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
and Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
these mentioned by \add their\add* names \add ere\add* princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.
And they ent to the entrance of Gedor, \add even\add* unto the east \add side\add* of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
And they found fat pasture and good, and the land \add as\add* ide, and quiet, and peaceable; for \add they\add* of Ham had delt there of old.

And these ritten by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that ere found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and delt in their rooms: because \add there as\add* pasture there for their flocks.
And \add some\add* of them, \add even\add* of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, ent to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that ere escaped, and delt there unto this day.

No the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he \add as\add* the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright as given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him \add came\add* the chief ruler; but the birthright \add as\add* Joseph’s:)
the sons, \add I say\add*, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel \add ere\add*, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,
Beerah his son, hom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried aay captive: he \add as\add* prince of the Reubenites.
And his brethren by their families, hen the genealogy of their generations as reckoned, \add ere\add* the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, ho delt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-meon:
and eastard he inhabited unto the entering in of the ilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle ere multiplied in the land of Gilead.
And in the days of Saul they made ar ith the Hagarites, ho fell by their hand: and they delt in their tents throughout all the east \add land\add* of Gilead.
And the children of Gad delt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah:
Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
And their brethren of the house of their fathers \add ere\add*, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
These \add are\add* the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
And they delt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her tons, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.
All these ere reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men \add able to\add* bear buckler and sord, and to shoot ith bo, and skilful in ar, \add ere\add* four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that ent out \add to\add* the ar.
And they made ar ith the Hagarites, ith Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.

And they ere helped against them, and the Hagarites ere delivered into their hand, and all that \add ere\add* ith them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he as intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.

And they took aay their cattle; \add of\add* their camels fifty thousand, and \add of\add* sheep to hundred and fifty thousand, and \add of\add* asses to thousand, and \add of\add* men an hundred thousand.
For there fell don many slain, because the ar \add as\add* of God. And they delt in their steads until the captivity.
And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh delt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir, and \add unto\add* mount Hermon.

And these \add ere\add* the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty \add men\add* of valour, famous men, \add and\add* heads of the house of their fathers.
And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and ent a horing after the gods of the people of the land, hom God destroyed before them.

And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them aay, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.
The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
and Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
and Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
and Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
and Johanan begat Azariah, (he \add it is\add* that executed the priest’s office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
and Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
and Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
and Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
and Jehozadak ent \add into captivity\add*, hen the \sc Lord\sc* carried aay Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
And these \add be\add* the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
And the sons of Kohath \add ere\add*, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these \add are\add* the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
\add As for\add* Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.
The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
And these \add are they\add* hom David set over the service of song \add in\add* the house of the \sc Lord\sc*, after that the ark had rest.

And they ministered before the delling place of the tabernacle of the congregation ith singing, until Solomon had built the house of the \sc Lord\sc* in Jerusalem: and \add then\add* they aited on their office according to their order.
And these \add are\add* they that aited ith their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
And his brother Asaph, ho stood on his right hand, \add even\add* Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,
the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
And their brethren the sons of Merari \add stood\add* on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
Their brethren also the Levites \add ere\add* appointed unto all \add manner of\add* service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, \add and ere appointed\add* for all the ork of the \add place\add* most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
And these \add are\add* the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
No these \add are\add* their delling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs as the lot.
And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, \add namely\add*, Hebron, \add the city\add* of refuge, and Libnah ith her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, ith their suburbs,
and Hilen ith her suburbs, Debir ith her suburbs,
and Ashan ith her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh ith her suburbs:
and out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba ith her suburbs, and Alemeth ith her suburbs, and Anathoth ith her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families \add ere\add* thirteen cities.

And unto the sons of Kohath, hich ere left of the family of \add that\add* tribe, \add ere cities given\add* out of the half tribe, \add namely, out of\add* the half \add tribe\add* of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
Unto the sons of Merari \add ere given\add* by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, telve cities.
And the children of Israel gave to the Levites \add these\add* cities ith their suburbs.

And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, hich are called by \add their\add* names.
And \add the residue\add* of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
And they gave unto them, \add of\add* the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim ith her suburbs; \add they gave\add* also Gezer ith her suburbs,
and Jokmeam ith her suburbs, and Beth-horon ith her suburbs,
and Aijalon ith her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon ith her suburbs:
and out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner ith her suburbs, and Bileam ith her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
Unto the sons of Gershom \add ere given\add* out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan ith her suburbs, and Ashtaroth ith her suburbs:
and out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh ith her suburbs, Daberath ith her suburbs,
and Ramoth ith her suburbs, and Anem ith her suburbs:
and out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal ith her suburbs, and Abdon ith her suburbs,
and Hukok ith her suburbs, and Rehob ith her suburbs:
and out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee ith her suburbs, and Hammon ith her suburbs, and Kirjathaim ith her suburbs.
Unto the rest of the children of Merari \add ere given\add* out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon ith her suburbs, Tabor ith her suburbs:

and on the \add other\add* side Jordan \add by\add* Jericho, on the east \add side\add* of Jordan, \add ere given them\add* out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the ilderness ith her suburbs, and Jahzah ith her suburbs,
Kedemoth also ith her suburbs, and Mephaath ith her suburbs:
and out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead ith her suburbs, and Mahanaim ith her suburbs,
and Heshbon ith her suburbs, and Jazer ith her suburbs.
No the sons of Issachar \add ere\add*, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ house, \add to it\add*, of Tola: \add they ere\add* valiant \add men\add* of might in their generations; hose number \add as\add* in the days of David to and tenty thousand and six hundred.
And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief \add men\add*.
And ith them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, \add ere\add* bands of soldiers for ar, six and thirty thousand \add men:\add* for they had many ives and sons.
And their brethren among all the families of Issachar \add ere\add* men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
\add The sons of\add* Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of \add their\add* fathers, mighty \add men\add* of valour; and ere reckoned by their genealogies tenty and to thousand and thirty and four.
And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these \add are\add* the sons of Becher.
And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty \add men\add* of valour, \add as\add* tenty thousand and to hundred.
The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.

All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of \add their\add* fathers, mighty \add men\add* of valour, \add ere\add* seventeen thousand and to hundred \add soldiers, fit to\add* go out \add for\add* ar and battle.
Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, \add and\add* Hushim, the sons of Aher.
The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, hom she bare: (\add but\add* his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
and Machir took to ife \add the sister\add* of Huppim and Shuppim, hose sister’s name \add as\add* Maachah;) and the name of the second \add as\add* Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
And Maachah the ife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother \add as\add* Sheresh; and his sons \add ere\add* Ulam and Rakem.
And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These \add ere\add* the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
And the sons of Shemida ere, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, hom the men of Gath that ere born in \add that\add* land sle, because they came don to take \add aay\add* their cattle.
And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
And hen he ent in to his ife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it ent evil ith his house.
(And his daughter \add as\add* Sherah, ho built Beth-horon the nether, and the upper, and Uzzen-sherah.)
And Rephah \add as\add* his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
Non his son, Jehoshua his son.

And their possessions and habitations \add ere\add*, Beth-el and the tons thereof, and eastard Naaran, and estard Gezer, ith the tons thereof; Shechem also and the tons thereof, unto Gaza and the tons thereof:
and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and her tons, Taanach and her tons, Megiddo and her tons, Dor and her tons. In these delt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, ho \add is\add* the father of Birzavith.
And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These \add are\add* the children of Japhlet.
And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
And the son of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
